steps.content: Outside the factory, the wooden sheep lies on its back. All of its perceptions stopped the moment before she left the factory.
She has been lying there for god knows how long, until the ground beneath her begins to loosen. A crudely constructed mechanical claw emerges from the ground, pulling the little sheep down.
Hey, is this a toy from the factory? How did it run out on its own?
There seems to have been a significant tremor just now. I found an opening. Let's go in together...
The location of the opening is roughly... let me see... here!
You don't know how long you've been unconscious, but for now, your body no longer feels the tearing pain. The cotton stays peacefully inside your body.
Amidst the dizziness, a lot of information floods into your cotton head. About the screaming chicken, the rubber ball, Eve, and Buonanotte Factory.
What's even stranger is that you feel a peculiar throbbing again from the other end of the shackles. The wooden sheep, which should have been disconnected, has re-entered your perception.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Pepper?

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: You finally woke up? Oliver has been by your side all along, yet you were calling out someone else's name? Oliver is so sad...
There's no sign of Pepper. The unfamiliar room is warm and tidy, a stark contrast to the rundown factory outside.
Oliver, slightly injured, is sitting on the floor, fiddling with the screaming chicken and rubber ball while mumbling complaints.

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: I told you, Eve is an unreasonable monster. But you insisted on getting close to her.

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: "We can talk it out..." blah, blah, blah...

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: Look at yourself now. So badly injured, and ending up in this weird place. Oliver's plan is going to fall apart...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Why are you here, too?

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: Huh? I thought you pulled me in?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: No...
Though you are unsure where this is, you can feel through the neat furnishings, soft lights, and comfortable temperature that this is a different dimension from the factory you've been in.
Your attention falls on the two toys in Oliver's hand.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: They also showed me some memories between them and Eve. The Eve in those memories seems different from the one we met... Something must have happened in between.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You were also brought here. Didn't you see those?

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: Hmm?... No, Oliver didn't see anything.

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: All I see is that the hope of escaping is gone. Oliver will have to be locked up here forever with you, and turned into a toy...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You really didn't see anything? Those seemed to be the memories these toys had with Eve.

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: What good are memories? Oliver is dumb and doesn't understand. Oliver only knows that you are now ragged and can't do anything.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: No... those memories are important.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: They are warm, happy, and joyful, completely different from the atmosphere of this factory.
You cover the overflowing cotton from your wound, endure the pain, and stand up to look around this unfamiliar space.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You have always assumed that Eve created this place with malicious intent. At first, I thought so too, considering the atmosphere of the factory is far from "beautiful."

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But maybe we are both wrong. The factory looks weird and scary, but this may not be Eve's intention.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: There must be many truths we haven't discovered yet.
Dreams, statues, illusions, games, the space-time constructed by Mania... You've experienced a lot. Undoubtedly, the creator's greatest wish must be the key to unravel all the predicaments.
The cotton inside your body is still restless, and the toyification continues. But thankfully, you feel Pepper's vitality again, and everything about this place is gradually becoming clear.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Oliver, it's not over yet. Before I completely turn into a toy, there's still a lot we can do.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I have decided to work with you, but with a slightly different plan.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Now, listen to me.

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: So you're saying, if we find more toy family members like these ones, we can find a way to restore this place faster?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Yes. Not to attract Eve's attention, but to get more information. After piecing together these bits and pieces of info, we will surely get closer to the truth of this factory.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The reason why Eve doesn't want to stop the toyification is not clear yet, but she's right about one thing.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Pepper is my friend, it's up to me to figure out how to save her.

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: So we still have to watch their warm and beautiful memories?
Oliver's tone is clearly full of disgust and resistance.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Didn't you just say you didn't see anything?

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: Ah... I, I just worry, worry that if you see too many warm memories, you will sympathize and can't bear to deal with them...

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: By then, if you turn against us, Oliver will really be alone... Eve is so scary. I don't want to meet her on my own!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Don't worry, she won't come here anytime soon. Though the blow of the shackles didn't directly hurt her just now, it should have caused a great impact.
Oliver seems to want to argue, but upon looking in your direction, turns pale with fright.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What's wrong? Did I speak of the devil? Eve isn't here, is she?

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: No... it's not Eve...

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: Don't turn around, doll. Whatever you do, don't turn around.

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: Some toys are not suitable for kids.
Seeing that you still don't understand, Oliver points behind you.
Before you can turn around, a big bloody mouth suddenly zooms out from behind. A row of sharp teeth fiercely pierces into your arm and tears it back forcefully.
Amidst the numbing sting, you clearly hear the sound of seams breaking at your arm!
